legendaryAction: Do not trigger combat here: the audience hall contains nine Steel Watchers plus Flaming Fists and civilians.
failureConditions: Attacking Gortash during the coronation creates the hardest version of the encounter
Skipping the coronation prevents Duke Ravengard from appearing alive in the Iron Throne
preparation: Keep summons and crimes away from the audience hall
Use dialogue rather than combat
Plan to speak with Mizora after leaving
completionChecks: Duke Ravengard was present and alive
irreversibleWarnings: Duke Ravengard can only be rescued from the Iron Throne if the coronation was attended
notes: Temporarily accepting Gortash's bargain is the reviewed low-risk route; it does not force the final alliance

failureConditions: Minsc receives lethal damage
A ranged attack, spell, surface, or rider delivers the final hit
Jaheira is dead or leaves the party
preparation: Bring Jaheira
Enable non-lethal attacks
Prepare a plain melee finisher and remove dangerous damage riders
completionChecks: Minsc knocked out with non-lethal melee damage
irreversibleWarnings: Killing Minsc can make Jaheira leave permanently
notes: The Emperor must extend protection after Minsc is subdued

legendaryAction: Vampiric Swarm can deal 12d12 piercing damage, push targets 7 m, and inflict Swarmed once per round.
failureConditions: Astarion remains trapped for three turns and Cazador completes the ritual
Vampiric Swarm pushes a character from the platform
Cazador retains all ritual sources
preparation: Reach level 12
Prepare Daylight or another sunlight source
Bring forced-movement protection, necrotic defence, and a mobile Help action
irreversibleWarnings: Astarion's ascension and the prisoners' fate alter his ending and final allies
notes: Each ritual source grants movement, temporary HP, and necrotic damage

legendaryAction: Heartwrench punishes a Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes Viconia or her allies; Sanctuary of Loss can protect Viconia when an ally is struck.
failureConditions: Radiant Retort reflects radiant damage back as doubled force damage
Darkness and crowd control disable the grouped party
Shadowheart is surrendered
preparation: Reach level 12
Bring darkness counters, Counterspell, summons, and non-radiant area damage
Spread before dialogue
irreversibleWarnings: Surrendering Shadowheart removes her permanently; the parents decision changes her ending
notes: Use Daylight to remove darkness, not radiant burst against enemies carrying Radiant Retort

legendaryAction: Raphael gains one legendary-action charge per Soul Pillar standing at the start of the round. He spends them on Beguiling Rebuke before ascending, then Soul Ascension for 6d10 necrotic damage and resistance-ignoring Hellfire support.
failureConditions: The alarm is raised before the archive and boudoir are ready
The party reaches the escape without restoring resources
Hope dies
Soul Pillars remain active
preparation: Reach level 12
Bring bludgeoning or force damage, Globe of Invulnerability, control, summons, and fire-independent offence
Wear Debtor's Attire
irreversibleWarnings: Fast travel and camp are unavailable; taking the Hammer or contract forces the escape battle
notes: The boudoir faucets can restore resources repeatedly on Honor until the Raphael fight begins

legendaryAction: Murderous Retort immediately strikes the first attacker once per round; with Deathbringer's Legacy it becomes a 20d10 Deathbringer Assault.
failureConditions: Echoes are killed first and grant permanent buffs to Sarevok
Death Knights join the encounter
A vulnerable attacker triggers the retort
preparation: Reach level 12
Bring a durable retort trigger, Turn Undead or control, and strong single-target damage
Use dialogue to separate Sarevok from the Echoes where possible
irreversibleWarnings: Becoming an Unholy Assassin is an incompatible branch from the reviewed good route
notes: Focus Sarevok while controlling or ignoring the Echoes; their deaths empower him

legendaryAction: Slayer Orin can react once per round with Sanguine Lash against a nearby attacker for 8d8 slashing damage, Bleeding, and knockback. If she does not use it, the Boon of Bhaal applies Bhaal's Edict: its target must kill another creature during its next turn or die.
failureConditions: The hostage dialogue fails
The hostage remains chained or dies before leaving the temple
Unstoppable is not removed before burst damage
A party member is knocked from the arena
preparation: Reach level 12
Bring Magic Missile, Scorching Ray, or other multi-hit attacks
Bring area damage for Sanctuary-protected chanters and Inspiration for the hostage dialogue
completionChecks: Hostage alive, unchained, and safely returned from the temple
irreversibleWarnings: A hostage left chained dies when the party leaves; a hostage killed after being freed cannot be revived
Dark Urge characters receive a distinct one-on-one duel with different failure consequences
notes: Ordinary long rests do not kill Orin's victim; the hostage becomes endangered during the direct confrontation

legendaryAction: Honor provides only five turns before every creature outside the submersible dies.
failureConditions: The Foundry is destroyed or Gortash is killed first
Ravengard was never moved by the coronation
Mizora's post-coronation camp offer was not resolved before entering
A rescuer or prisoner remains below after turn five
preparation: Complete the coronation and Mizora camp scene
Assign east, west, and south corridors
Prepare Longstrider, Haste, Fly, Dimension Door, Misty Step, Sanctuary, healing, and ranged lever attacks
irreversibleWarnings: Docking breaks Gortash's bargain and starts the five-turn collapse; the prison cannot be revisited
notes: Omeluum can teleport itself and one ally to the submersible once per round

legendaryAction: Honor Bulwark grants 200 temporary HP, blocks damage below 40, repairs 6d8+14 HP, and enables Hellfire Missiles.
failureConditions: A dropped Motivator is left active
Bulwark and Hellfire Missiles are ignored
The party remains beside a self-detonating Watcher
preparation: Complete the Iron Throne first
Bring Flashblinder grenades, control, Globe of Invulnerability, and burst damage
Keep Zanner Toobin alive or preserve another Neurocitor solution
irreversibleWarnings: Destroying the Foundry before the Iron Throne kills its prisoners
notes: Flashblinders remove Bulwark and stun the Titan even on Honor

source.sheet: BG3 Wiki - Steel Watcher Titan combat

legendaryAction: At the start of each round Draconic Wrath makes Ansur retaliate against the first attacker with Lightning Breath.
failureConditions: The party has no answer to Stormheart Nova
The post-nova rain makes the party Wet and vulnerable to lightning
Unrelenting Storm's final 100 temporary HP are not planned for
preparation: Reach level 12
Bring lightning resistance, Globe of Invulnerability, mobility, summons, and reserved burst damage
Choose a durable first attacker each round
notes: The first lethal hit leaves Ansur at 1 HP with 100 temporary HP for one round and starts another nova

legendaryAction: Tyrannical Branding places Tyrant's Curse; unless removed, Bane's fist falls at the end of the target's next turn for 20d10 force damage.
failureConditions: The Steel Watch remains active
Tyrant's Curse is not removed, even after Gortash dies or combat ends
Grenade impellers and force curtains control the arena
preparation: Defeat Orin and disable the Steel Watch
Bring Remove Curse, trap disarming, summons, and mobile ranged damage
Bring Karlach if her confrontation is desired
irreversibleWarnings: Killing Gortash before the Iron Throne destroys the prison
notes: Fight in his office only after the fortress has been weakened

failureConditions: The skiff is used with equipment or party members left at camp
The Astral Prism choice leaves no valid illithid wielder
Resources are exhausted before the brainstem
preparation: Finish all optional content
Carry all three Netherstones and the Orphic Hammer if required
Finalize the party, gear, allies, and restoration consumables; apply elixirs and Until Long Rest buffs only after the forced Astral Prism rest
completionChecks: Party reaches the brainstem with resources intact
irreversibleWarnings: Using the Morphic Pool skiff permanently removes camp, storage, party swaps, Withers, respecs, and ordinary long rests
notes: Sneaking or invisibility can bypass the Morphic Pool intellect-devourer ambush

legendaryAction: Aegis of the Absolute makes the brain immune to every damage type it took during the preceding round; the first time it takes damage each round it can spend its reaction on a 10d6 Retributive Brainquake around the attacker.
failureConditions: The outer four-turn counter expires and Nautiloid bombardment begins
Karsus' Compulsion is interrupted before the caster's next turn
The party enters the portal piecemeal
The Netherbrain is not killed within the inner five-turn countdown
Orbs of Negation destroy occupied platforms
Every available damage type is used in one round
preparation: Bring Globe of Invulnerability, Sanctuary, Counterspell, mobility, psychic protection, and two separate damage palettes
Use allies as distractions
Gather the full party at the Crown before completing the channel
completionChecks: Netherbrain reduced to zero within five inner turns and before platforms were destroyed
Final destroy or control decision completed
irreversibleWarnings: The final destroy/control decision determines the ending
notes: Use physical damage in one round and non-physical types in the next, accounting for weapon riders
